invariants.rationale: type must be one of the supported types, otherwise an exception is thrown.
For string, file, or null types, the returned result must be the input value.
If type is 'int', result is the Integer value of the string 'value'.
If type is 'float', result is the Float value of the string 'value'.
If type is 'bool', result is the Boolean value of the string 'value'.
